high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Hell of a Summer." The poster features a group of young people standing together, seemingly in a state of alarm or fear. They are dressed casually, with some wearing t-shirts, shorts, and sneakers, while others have more varied attire. The background is plain white, which makes the characters stand out prominently. In the foreground, there is a large axe with blood splattered on it, held by a gloved hand. The glove is red, adding to the ominous and horror-themed atmosphere of the poster.
